Toyo Gosei.why: Its largest segment, Photosensitive Materials, sells materials for advanced photoresists whose sales grow with leading-edge (generative AI) chip production.
Toyo Gosei.evidence: Q1 results presentation (08-07-2026): 'Growing demand in leading-edge applications, including generative AI, drove a significant increase in sales of advanced photoresist materials.'

players.product: Photosensitive materials for advanced photoresists (Photosensitive Materials segment); high-purity solvents for advanced logic and memory

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Gosei results presentation: Financial Results for Q1 of the Fiscal Year Ending March 31, 2027 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Toyo Gosei Q1 of the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 (April-June 2026): net sales rose 32% YoY to a quarterly record JPY 12,086 million, driven by higher sales of advanced semiconductor materials; operating profit reached a quarterly record JPY 1,932 million (4.9 times the prior-year level), including a temporary JPY 0.51 billion benefit related to increased production in the previous fiscal year.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 12,086 million net sales (+32%); JPY 1,932 million operating profit

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Gosei results presentation: Financial Results for Q1 of the Fiscal Year Ending March 31, 2027 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Photosensitive Materials segment Q1: net sales JPY 7,382 million, up 38% YoY; growing demand in leading-edge applications, including generative AI, drove a significant increase in sales of advanced photoresist materials; operating profit JPY 1,052 million versus an operating loss of JPY 233 million a year earlier. The company says the investment payback phase for the expanded facilities is now well underway.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 7,382 million segment net sales (+38%); JPY 1,052 million segment operating profit

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Gosei results presentation: Financial Results for Q1 of the Fiscal Year Ending March 31, 2027 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chemicals segment Q1: record net sales of JPY 4,704 million (+24% YoY); sales of high-purity solvents increased, mainly for advanced logic and memory applications.

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Gosei results presentation: Financial Results for Q1 of the Fiscal Year Ending March 31, 2027 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Forecast raised in August 2026 on increased demand for advanced semiconductor materials: fiscal year ending March 2027 net sales JPY 50.0 billion (+5% vs. the May forecast, +19% YoY) and operating profit JPY 5.8 billion (+16% vs. May, +58% YoY), with net sales and all profit measures expected at record highs; H1 net sales JPY 24.5 billion and operating profit JPY 3.5 billion; H2 net sales JPY 25.5 billion and operating profit JPY 2.3 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 50.0 billion net sales; JPY 5.8 billion operating profit (FY ending March 2027)

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Gosei results presentation: Financial Results for Q1 of the Fiscal Year Ending March 31, 2027 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 'Beyond 500' medium-term plan: net sales are forecast to reach the JPY 50.0 billion target, but operating profit is expected to reach 73% of the JPY 8.0 billion target due to higher fixed costs; cumulative capital expenditures of JPY 32.76 billion versus approx. JPY 30.0 billion planned, above plan due to inflation.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 32.76 billion cumulative capex; 73% of the JPY 8.0 billion operating profit target
